test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In May 2025, which Indian company emerged as the lowest bidder for the Indian Navy’s Next Generation Corvettes (NGC) project, valued at over ₹25,000 crore?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE)**, a Kolkata-based government-owned shipbuilding company, emerged as the lowest bidder for the Indian Navy's Next Generation Corvettes (NGC) project in May 2025.
 
• The NGC project is valued at over ₹25,000 crore and includes the construction of state-of-the-art corvettes equipped with advanced technology for coastal and deep-sea operations.
 
• GRSE has a proven track record of delivering high-quality naval vessels, including warships, patrol boats, and corvettes for the Indian Navy and Coast Guard.
 
• This bid highlights GRSE's capability to handle large-scale defense contracts and its contribution to India's goal of self-reliance in defense manufacturing under the "Make in India" initiative.
 
• The Next Generation Corvettes are expected to bolster the Indian Navy's operational capabilities and contribute to maritime security in the Indian Ocean Region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustan Shipyard Limited**

 
 
• Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) is a government-owned shipyard located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Established in 1941, HSL primarily focuses on shipbuilding, ship repairs, and submarine construction.
 
• While it plays a crucial role in India's defense sector, HSL did not emerge as the lowest bidder for the NGC project.
 
 
 
• **Cochin Shipyard Limited**
 
 
• Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), located in Kochi, Kerala, is one of the largest shipbuilding and maintenance facilities in India.
 
• It is renowned for constructing high-quality commercial and defense vessels, including India's first indigenous aircraft carrier, INS Vikrant.
 
• Despite its significant contributions to the defense sector, CSL was not the lowest bidder for this specific project.
 
 
 
• **Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited**
 
 
• Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) is a leading defense public sector undertaking headquartered in Mumbai.
 
• It specializes in building warships, submarines, and other naval vessels for the Indian Navy.
 
• MDL is involved in several prestigious defense projects but was not selected as the lowest bidder for the NGC project.
